= callout-guards(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-05
:source-highlighter: syntect
:icons: font

== Name
callout-guards - icon settings and comment guards

== Synopsis

[source,rust,linenums,start=10,highlight="10,11"]
----
G01 call(); // <1>
G02 call(); # <2>
G03 call(); ;; <3>
G04 call(); -- <4>
G05 call(); //  <5>
G06 call();//<6><7>
G07 // <8>
// <9>
----
<1> Slash guard.
<2> Hash guard in Rust.
<3> Semicolon guard in Rust.
<4> Dash guard in Rust.
<5> Two spaces preserve the guard.
<6> No space is added.
<7> Adjacent marker.
<8> Marker-only line after guard removal.
<9> Entire guard fragment disappears.

[source,xml]
----
G08 <tag/> <!--1--><!--2-->
G09 <tag/><!--3--> <!--4-->
G10 <tag/> <!-- ordinary --> <!--5-->
G11 <tag/> <!--6--> suffix
G12 <tag/> \<!--7-->
----
<1> First XML marker.
<2> Adjacent XML marker.
<3> No space before XML guard.
<4> Authored space.
<5> Ordinary comments stay.

[source,erlang,line-comment=%]
----
G13 call(). % <1>
G14 call(). # <2>
----
<1> Custom guard.
<2> Default guard stays with a custom prefix.

[source,rust,line-comment=]
----
G15 call(); // <1>
----
<1> Explicitly disabled stripping.

[source,text,line-comment="※"]
----
G16 café ※ <.>
G17 café ※<.>
----
<.> Unicode custom prefix.
<.> Automatic number without added spacing.

....
G18 literal // <1>
G19 literal <!--2-->
....
<1> Literal slash guard.
<2> Literal XML guard.

:icons!:

[source,rust]
----
G20 call(); // <1>
G21 <tag/> <!--2-->
----
<1> Text marker retains its guard.
<2> Text marker retains both XML guards.

:icons: font

[source,text]
----
G22 restored # <1>
----
<1> Font marker restored in the body.
